verdict.rationale: AWS ships Amazon Bedrock AgentCore as a first-party end-to-end platform to build, deploy and run agents in production. The evidence covers framework-agnostic deployment (LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK, Strands, etc.), the same code going from laptop to production, built-in authentication and access control for tool calls, and step-level observability. Missing for 10: in-depth technical docs on runtime/orchestration internals (only marketing-page claims are cited), independent or hands-on corroboration that AgentCore works in production.
